name: Rauthy Open-Source Self-Hosted OIDC Identity Provider
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed self-hosted OpenID Connect/OAuth 2.0 identity provider with passkeys, admin UI and optional high availability; no vendor subscription or published self-hosted user quota.
watch_out: You must supply and secure your own host, TLS, backups, outbound email and any external dependencies; infrastructure is not free. Professional support is paid. LOCAL_TEST mode uses an unsafe demo configuration and must not be used in production.
